description: An accepted inception committing to the digest of a1, then a rotation to an unrelated key x, signed by x. The rotation's keys include no subset of the prior next keys, so a validator must not accept it (lines 1262 and 1494), and its key state stays the inception's. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0021 (KS-25) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: rotation that breaks the pre-rotation commitment
